description.value: Port Browning Pub is a waterfront pub at Port Browning Marina on Pender Island, recognized as one of the top gathering spots in the Gulf Islands. The newly renovated space offers classic burgers, pub fare, local and international beers on tap, local cider, and a welcoming family-friendly atmosphere with both indoor and outdoor seating. It sits within a full marina resort complex that includes accommodations, a bistro, swimming pool, and kayak rentals — making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the Gulf Islands.
